text:
nina: Quick sync - OrionPay wants a performance POC for costed transaction scoring. Acceptance: sustain 1.2k qps for 10m, p95 <150ms, and <0.5% error rate. They also want evidence of isolated capacity and KMS + log retention controls. Who can run this?

devon: I can coordinate the load run. Question: model? They said small LM for rerank/scoring - redwood-2b-qr. Want non-quant for fidelity, but ok to failover to q4_0 for extreme bursts.

priya: For plan: recommend Dedicated-like pool (4 x A100-equiv), disable autoscale, pin placement in us-east-1. Warmup to warm KV and embeddings cache. Mix: 80% short requests (~40 tokens), 20% long (~500 tokens).

nina: Good. Also requirement: cold-start <800ms when we scale an extra host. Add that to runbook.

devon: Runbook draft: 
1) Reserve pool window 02:00-06:00 PT, no other traffic
2) Warmup: 8k requests over 12m to populate KV and batched caches
3) Ramp: 100 -> 500 -> 900 -> 1200 qps (3m steps)
4) Sustain: hold 1200 qps for 10m, capture p50/p90/p95/p99, gpu util, per-host queue depth
5) Burst test: 1500 qps for 90s to force fallback to q4_0
6) Scale-add test: add 1 host mid-sustain to measure cold-start
7) Teardown + collect traces, trace-ids, and token breakdown

devon: command snippet for load generator: 
`lbctl run --endpoint https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate --model redwood-2b-qr --mix mix.json --ramp 03:00 --target 1200 --duration 10:00 --capture traces,metrics`

priya: mix.json will be 80/20 short/long with 5% malformed edgecases to validate error handling. Also record 300 outputs for QA sampling.

alexa: Security checklist from OrionPay: 1) Can we guarantee region-bound processing? 2) Customer-managed KMS for model keys? 3) How long do you retain logs/traces? 4) Access control for raw prompts during debugging?

security-team: Answers: Region-bound processing yes for Dedicated pools; KMS: we support customer keys via KMS connector (need onboarding form); logs default retention 30d but can be configured; raw prompts not persisted in plaintext in shared buckets, debug access audited and role-based. We'll prepare a redacted SOC2 bundle.

nina: Infra asks: can we expose per-request token+cost breakdown in the post-run report? They want to compare unit economics vs their existing in-house solution.

devon: Yes - capture tokens/request, tokens/sec, estimated $/req at hosted rates and also compute-only estimate for dedicated nodes. We'll include graphs.

priya: Need to set queue_max=8k, per-host max_concurrency=50, and kv_cache_size to recommended. Also enable perf_exporter and increase trace sampling to 100% for the run.

infra-bot: [reserve] pool-orionpay-4nodes reserved 2026-02-14T02:00:00Z -> 2026-02-14T06:00:00Z :white_check_mark:

devon: Cost sketch for customer call: (a) Dedicated reservation 4 nodes for 4h -> ~$ZZZ; (b) Hosted equivalent (elastic) for 4h + tokens -> ~$YYY. I'll post numbers after I calc with avg tokens=220.

alexa: Also flag enterprise blocker: OrionPay will require VPC peering and IP allowlist for the test. Need SRE signoff and contact info for their networking team.

security-team: VPC peering is supported for Private deployments. For hosted Dedicated-like pools we can set IP allowlist for the test window, but we need a signed NDA + IP list 48h prior.

nina: Action items: devon runbook owner, priya prepare prompts+mix, alexa own security packets + NDA, devon calc cost, infra-bot confirmed reservation. Meet tomorrow 09:00 PT for dry-run.

priya: I'll upload sample_prompts_mix.json and 1k prompt bundle to the run folder by EOD.

devon: I'll run a 20m smoke at 08:30 PT then main run at 02:00 PT. Will post logs and summary in this thread after run.

nina: Thanks team. Let's make sure we capture unit economics and fallback behavior in the report. :rocket:
